entries.name: FREOVIA Design System Validator
entries.problem: Detect drift in the shared FREOVIA design-token and semantic financial-state contract.
entries.output_contract: Deterministic pass/fail with a specific contract-drift reason

cost.notes: Local deterministic Node.js validation; no network or model call.

entries.notes: Approval is limited to deterministic repository contract validation; it does not replace visual/browser review.

entries.name: Securities Browser Smoke
entries.problem: Run browser-level smoke checks for the public securities exam surface before release.
